claims.evidence: One source per culture (genotype x clone x SILAC round x compartment x time point) and per channel role. MaxQuant experiment names encode round (1/2/2X), compartment (CELLS/MITO), time point (t0/t6/t24), genotype letter (W/H/C) and clone number (1-3). Supp Methods: "Data were obtained in three independent cell clones per genotype in two entirely independent biological replicates corresponding to two rounds of SILAC labeling." Pulsed medium and heavy channels from one lysate are separate sources (precedent PXD028934). Three runs filed as W1-3 are CLPB KO with clone number unconfirmed ("clone-unconfirmed-fileWn"); one run filed as experiment "2CELLS_t0_H" has clone 3 inferred ("clone3-inferred-fileH").

claims.value: SILAC light / SILAC medium / SILAC heavy
claims.evidence: summary.txt: Multiplicity 3, Labels0 empty (light), Labels1 Arg6;Lys4 (medium), Labels2 Arg10;Lys8 (heavy) for all 108 searched runs. Paper: "cultured in medium containing ... light [L] or ... medium [M] ... Then, M-labeled cells were subjected to medium containing ... heavy, H to initiate pulse labeling ... ratios of H/L and M/L reflect different prote[in synthesis and persistence]". Supp: "Pulsed cells were mixed with the same number of light labeled cells". Hence light = unpulsed light-cultured reference cells, medium = pre-existing proteome of pulsed cells, heavy = proteins synthesised during the pulse. PRIDE:0000326/0000327/0000325 verified.

claims.value: wild type / HAX1 knockout / CLPB knockout
claims.evidence: Paper: "PLB-985 cells (WT, HAX1-/-, and CLPB-/-)". Letter code from MaxQuant experiment names, verified on data (genotype_check.txt): H runs have HAX1 Intensity 0 in L, M and H (except anomalies below); C runs have CLPB Intensity 0 in M and H; W runs have both. The light channel carries the same KO as the pulsed cells, so the light reference cells are of the same genotype (consistent with the paper's WT vs HAX1-/- light-LFQ volcano, "n = 18 each, 2 replicates"). 2CELLS_t6_W1/W2/W3 runs: submitter sheet "CLPB ko, not wt"; CLPB = 0 in all channels -> CLPB knockout.

claims.evidence: Experiment names CELLS vs MITO. Supp: "1 x 10^6 heavy-pulsed + light cells were washed with PBS and pelleted ... 3 x 10^6 heavy-pulsed + light cells were further processed for the isolation of mitochondria". Paper: "we isolated either whole cells or mitochondria". GO:0005739 mitochondrion; "cell" (GO cellular component label, as curated precedent PXD070730). Custom characteristics column (batch rule 16).

claims.location: characteristics[sampling time], factor value[sampling time] rows 1-318
claims.evidence: Supp: "At time 0, 6 hours and 24 hours, pulsed cells were collected"; experiment names t0/t6/t24. The value is the heavy-pulse duration of the mix; the light reference rows carry the time point of the mix they were combined into (they were mixed at that time point: "pulsed cells were collected and counted ... mixed with the same number of cells cultured in light medium").

claims.value: (round-1)*3 + clone number (1-6), shared by the three channel rows of one culture
claims.evidence: Supp: three independent clones per genotype x two rounds of SILAC labelling = 6 cultures per genotype; paper: "n = 6 per genotype". Round from the experiment prefix; 2X_ experiments (raw files dated 20180312 on QX0) are round 2: mean M/L correlation to round-2 runs 0.43-0.60 vs -0.17 to -0.56 to round-1 runs (ratio_check.txt); 107/108 experiments match their prefix (2MITO_t24_H1 borderline 0.21 vs 0.25, kept as named). CLPB-KO fileW1/W2/W3 get 4/5/6 in file order (clone identity unconfirmed; clone signature supports W1->C1, weakly W3->C3). fileH gets 6 (clone 3): its light-channel clone signature is reciprocal-best with 2CELLS_t24_H3 (r=0.33) and 2CELLS_t6_H3 (0.23), and round-2 cells t0 otherwise lacks H3 while 2X_CELLS_t0_H1 supplies H1.

claims.value: 1; 2 for the second run of the same culture (round-2 cells t0 WT clones 2 and 3: 2X_ then Repeat_; HAX1-KO clone 2 cells 24h: t24_H2 then Repeat_t24_H2)
claims.evidence: Only two SILAC rounds exist (supp), and ratio_check assigns the Repeat_ and 2X_ runs to round 2, so a second run of the same genotype/clone/round/compartment/time is a repeat measurement or re-preparation of the same culture, not a new culture. Repeat_t24_H2 vs t24_H2: M/L r=0.75, H/L r=0.80 (highest pair).

limitations: Scope: 106 of 107 deposited triple-SILAC raw files annotated (318 rows). BLOCKED: 20180614_QX0_MaMu_SA_M362_PBL985SILAC_MITO_t6_H1.raw - labelled HAX1-/- clone H1, but HAX1 is identified by MS/MS (8 peptides) at WT-level intensity in the L, M and H channels while clone H1 has HAX1 = 0 in its other runs; sample identity contradicted by the data (BLOCKED.md). Not deposited: 20180312_QX8_MaMu_SA_PBL985_MITO_t0_H1.raw (in summary.txt, absent from the raw archive).
The HSP27 FLAG-IP raw files (label-free, HEK293T) are in the separate SDRF PXD023790-hsp27-ip.sdrf.tsv (batch rule 12).

comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available: MaxQuant 1.6.1.13 parameters.txt/summary.txt do not record the group-specific first/main-search precursor tolerance and no mqpar.xml was deposited. The paper/PRIDE text says "initial precursor mass deviation up to 7 ppm", but the same sentence gives a 10 ppm fragment tolerance that the deposited parameters.txt (20 ppm FTMS) contradicts, so that sentence is not used. Consequence: parse_sdrf convert-openms exits 1 ("Cannot read precursor mass tolerance"); a probe with a filled tolerance converts (18 conditions).

Clone identity of the three CLPB-KO runs filed as 2CELLS_t6_W1/W2/W3 is not documented (submitter note only says "CLPB ko, not wt"); biological replicates 4/5/6 follow file order and source names say clone-unconfirmed.

Clone of experiment "2CELLS_t0_H" (file 20180612_..._CELLS_t0_H.raw) is inferred as clone 3 from a light-channel clone signature (reciprocal best match with the round-2 H3 runs) plus the gap in the design; it is not stated anywhere.

Light reference cells: the paper says pulsed cells were mixed with "light labeled cells" without naming the clone; the data show the light channel carries the same knockout as the pulsed cells (HAX1/CLPB absent in L), so light rows get the same genotype/clone/round. That the light cells are the same clone (not another clone of the same genotype) is inferred.
2X_ runs carry a 20180312 file date but are assigned to round 2 per the experiment prefix and the ratio-correlation batch check; 2MITO_t24_H1 has a borderline round signature and is kept as named.
Minor HAX1 signal in 1MITO_t6_H2 (2 peptides, ~5% of WT intensity) and 1MITO_t24_H2 (1 peptide) is treated as carry-over/noise; those runs are kept as HAX1 knockout.

characteristics[cell type], passage number, sample storage temperature = not available (not stated; "more than 10 passages in SILAC medium" is not a passage number). Reduction/alkylation reagents not stated (PreOmics LYSE kit), columns omitted; Carbamidomethyl is from the search.
Raw-header verification limited to 4 of 106 SILAC files (techsdrf not installable); dissociation/NCE/scan range assumed uniform.
PRIDE structured fields disagree with the record: instrument "Q Exactive HF" (raw: HF-X); disease "neutropenia" (the cells are a leukemia line); "No PTMs" (search has several).
